summary: Reduces a user-typed prompt to find terms (embedder step 4): identifiers taken by character offset (isId: inner _./-, camelCase, 2+ capitals, letter+digit), quoted 2-4-word UI labels as CamelCase, then wink-nlp NOUN/PROPN tokens >= 3 chars not inside an id; < 2 terms → skip. Two gates added 2026-11-18: an all-letters ALL-CAPS word stays an id only if wink tags it NOUN/PROPN and it is not in EMPHASIS (wink tags IMPORTANT/NOTE as PROPN) — symptom before: NOT/ONLY/MUST became find terms; on v-prompt1 dev it drops NOT x1, ONLY x2, keeps every acronym, 0 skip flips. And ids longer than MAX_ID_LEN (80) are dropped (pasted JWT/base64 tokens). The wink model loads lazily on first reducePrompt (~70 ms) — file-inject only calls it after the embedder opt-in check. Ids dedupe case-insensitively keeping the LAST spelling (pilot parity).
